subject: Next steps: tax residency decision and PO hold for Acme Consulting
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-consulting.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: tax residency decision and PO hold for Acme Consulting

Hi Liam,

Thanks for sending the initial onboarding packet last week. We're preparing the PO but have a quick tax question before we finalize. The W-9 you uploaded lists an EIN that doesn't match the legal name on your supplier profile ("Acme Consulting US Subsidiary" vs "Acme Consulting LLC"). Our finance team needs one of the following to clear the PO: a corrected W-9 with matching legal-name/EIN, an IRS CP575/confirmation letter, or a notarized bank letter confirming the EIN.

Can you confirm whether the uploaded W-9 was completed for the US operating entity or the parent? If the entity is a foreign entity, we'll need a W-8BEN-E instead — please let us know the residency claim so we can route correctly.

PO status: on hold pending verification. Estimated hold window: 3 business days once we receive the supporting evidence.

Next steps (proposed):
- If US entity: send corrected W-9 (PDF) and one supporting proof (IRS letter or bank letter).
- If foreign entity: send completed W-8BEN-E + certificate of foreign status and government-issued registration.

Thanks — setting up a short call if that's easier.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PO-12345-preflight.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)]
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-consulting.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: ACME Accounting <accounting@acme-consulting.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: tax residency decision and PO hold for Acme Consulting

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the note and sorry for the confusion. The W-9 we uploaded was completed by our US subsidiary (Acme Consulting US Subsidiary), which operates under a DBA and has its own EIN. Our vendor profile mistakenly lists the parent company name. I've attached the filled W-9 that our accounting team submitted and a short cover note.

Attachments:
- acme_w9_filled.pdf (PDF, 412 KB) — W-9 filled by Acme Consulting US Subsidiary
- acme_w9_scanned_letter.pdf (PDF, 78 KB) — internal cover note from Acme accounting explaining DBA usage

Would a bank letter confirming the EIN work? We can request that and get it to you in 1–2 business days. Alternatively we can update the supplier profile to match the subsidiary name if Redwood prefers that for payment records.

Let me know which route you prefer and we'll action it today.

Best regards,
Liam O'Connor
Operations Lead | Acme Consulting
liam.oconnor@acme-consulting.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-consulting.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: tax residency decision and PO hold for Acme Consulting

Liam —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. Monica and I reviewed the W-9 and the cover note; because the legal name on our vendor profile is the parent company, our AP system flags the EIN/name mismatch as a tax identity exception. The quickest path to clear the PO is either:

Option A (preferred): update the Redwood supplier record to the subsidiary legal name + re-upload the W-9 so payment and tax reporting align.

Option B: keep profile as parent + provide a bank letter or IRS confirmation that ties the subsidiary name to the EIN you provided (bank letter preferred since it is faster). The bank letter should be on bank letterhead, dated, and explicitly reference the EIN.

If you choose Option A, please confirm the exact legal entity name and provide a copy of the articles of incorporation or a government registration so our Vendor Ops team can make the change. If you choose Option B, upload the bank letter and we'll move forward with PO issuance.

For transparency: if we can't resolve the identity within 5 business days the PO will remain on hold and payouts may shift to the next payment cycle.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min call if that helps speed things up.

Kim

Hi Kimberly/Monica —

Thanks for outlining the options. Per your preference we'll proceed with Option B and have the bank issue a confirmation letter. Attached is a draft bank letter they provided for Redwood review; final signed PDF will be uploaded by end of day tomorrow.

Attachment stub: bank_letter_ein_confirmation.pdf (PDF, 256 KB) — draft bank confirmation referencing EIN 12-3456789 and Acme Consulting US Subsidiary
